# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

**Best overall: JBL Charge 6 (about $130-$150)**
- Three of the sources name it top pick or best overall: What Hi-Fi, BestProducts and iTechGuides.
- It has an IP68 rating, 20 hours of battery (28 with Playtime Boost) and 40W of power.
- It can charge your phone, and it has a removable carrying handle.
- The sources I have don't say whether it floats, so keep it off the pool edge.
- Prices: $129.99 at Walmart, $149.95 at Amazon, $159.95 at Best Buy (What Hi-Fi).
- Buy links: [What Hi-Fi's Charge 6 listing](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) or [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/), which both link to retailers.

**Best budget: Ultimate Ears WONDERBOOM 4 (about $65-$80)**
- It's about the size of a softball, floats, is rated IP67 and gives 360-degree sound.
- Battery is up to 14 hours, and it's rubberized, so it handles drops.
- It has no companion app, and it's quieter than the bigger speakers here.
- Buy links: [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) (Amazon, Walmart, Lowe's) or [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth).

**Best for pool parties: JBL Boombox 4 (premium price)**
- RTINGS' top waterproof pick. It floats, can be immersed for long periods and lasts over 40 hours.
- It gets loud with balanced sound, though it sounds muffled if you're beside or behind it.
- Buy links (Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart): [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth).

**Best mid-range for a group: Ultimate Ears EPICBOOM**
- Tom's Guide's best overall and RTINGS' best mid-range pick.
- It has 360-degree sound, is IP67, floats, and gets about 15 hours of battery.
- Buy links: [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers) (Amazon, Newegg) or [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth).

**Best small and cheap: JBL Go 5 (about $40)**
- It's soap-sized and IP67, with up to 8 hours of battery. It's a good backup speaker for a beach bag.
- Buy link: [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) lists Amazon at $39.95.

**Discount option: Soundcore Boom 3i**
- It's a rugged waterproof speaker. I have no independent review of it in these results.
- Dealectric's tested code **AFSC20** takes it from $129.99 to $104 as of Oct 22: [buy link](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-3i). That link is an affiliate link, which pays Dealectric at no extra cost to you.
- The same code also covers the Soundcore Boom 2 Plus ($249.99 to $200): [buy link](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus).

**Care tips for the pool and beach**
- IP ratings don't cover salt or chlorine damage (RTINGS). Rinse with fresh water if the manual allows it, and let the speaker dry before charging.
- Keep the charging port flap closed, and set the speaker on a towel rather than in the sand.
- IP67 or better is the target for a pool or beach (Tom's Guide, Good Housekeeping).

If you want one pick, get the JBL Charge 6. If you'd rather spend less, or want a speaker that floats, get the WONDERBOOM 4.
